title: The Biggest Glued Number
statement:
You have `n` non-negative integers written in decimal. Glue them together in any order, writing them one after another with nothing between, to form one long number. Find the order that makes this long number as large as possible.

The long number can have up to about 190 000 digits, so print its value modulo `1000000007`. Leading zeros do not matter for the value.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains `n` integers.

## Output
Print the largest possible long number, taken modulo `1000000007`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 17000`
- `0 <= a_i <= 10^9`
